name: Starmesh
install: go mod download && go build -o dist/starmesh ./hub/cmd/starmesh && (test -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" || git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter") && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" config --enable-web --no-analytics && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" precache --web && (cd app && "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" pub get)

terminals.name: dev-hub
terminals.description: Local Starmesh dev hub (loopback IPv6, --dev). Exposes the loopback JSON API on 127.0.0.1:7780 (GET /v1/status, /v1/invite). Connect spokes with: ./dist/starmesh spoke --name alice --home /tmp/alice --invite "$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:7780/v1/invite | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["invite"])')"

terminals.name: dev-ui
terminals.description: Flutter web UI dev server on :8080. Talks to the local daemon JSON API on 127.0.0.1:7780. Run `flutter analyze` in ./app to lint the UI.
